Compare Bayesian calibration models

Source: R/cal.compare.R
cal.compare.Rd

Compares the models in a cal.bayesian() result using approximate leave-one-out cross-validation (PSIS-LOO).

Usage

cal.compare(fit)

Arguments

fit

A result from cal.bayesian() with at least two models.

Value

The result of loo::loo_compare(). The best model is in the first row.

Details

In models with measurement errors, the pointwise log-likelihood is conditional on the latent true temperatures. A warning is given when any Pareto k value is above 0.7, since the comparison may then be unreliable.

Examples

# \donttest{
ds <- cal.dataset(error = "S1", nobs = 50, seed = 1)
fit <- cal.bayesian(ds, models = c("errors", "noerrors"), numSavedSteps = 1000)
#> Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)): error in evaluating the argument 'object' in selecting a method for function 'sampling': Boost not found; call install.packages('BH')
cal.compare(fit)
#> Error: object 'fit' not found
# }
